section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: VO Tech ("we," "our," or "us"), a company registered in the Republic of Malta, is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our services, including our website pollo.lol and related applications (collectively, the "Services"). We adhere to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws. By using our Services, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

list.item1: Wallet Address: When you log in using your crypto wallet, we collect your public wallet address.
list.item2: Email Address (Optional): If you choose to participate in our leaderboard, we collect your email address.

subsection2.title: 2.2 Automatically Collected Information
subsection2.content: This information is used for maintaining the security and operation of our Services, as well as for analytical purposes.

list.item2: Financial information beyond transaction data visible on the blockchain
list.item3: Personal identification information (unless voluntarily provided for specific features like Leaderboard access)

list.item1: To provide and maintain our Services
list.item2: To allow you to participate in interactive features of our Services, such as the leaderboard
list.item3: To monitor the usage of our Services
list.item4: To detect, prevent and address technical issues

section4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data Under GDPR

list.item1: Consent: You have given clear consent for us to process your personal data for a specific purpose (e.g., leaderboard participation).
list.item2: Contract: The processing is necessary for a contract we have with you or because you have asked us to take specific steps before entering into a contract.
list.item3: Legitimate Interests: The processing is necessary for our legitimate interests or the legitimate interests of a third party, unless there is a good reason to protect your personal data which overrides those legitimate interests.

section5.title: 5. Retention of Data
section5.content: We will retain your wallet address for as long as necessary to provide our Services. If you provide an email address for leaderboard participation, we will retain it until you request its removal or your account becomes inactive.

section6.title: 6. Transfer of Data
section6.content: Your information, including personal data, may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ from those of your jurisdiction. If you are located outside Malta and choose to provide information to us, please note that we transfer the data, including personal data, to Malta and process it there. Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission of such information represents your agreement to that transfer.

section7.title: 7. Disclosure of Data
section7.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information regarding visitors and users with our business partners, trusted affiliates, and advertisers for the purposes outlined above.

section8.title: 8. Security of Data
section8.content: We prioritize the security of your data but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

section9.title: 9. Your Data Protection Rights Under GDPR

list.item1: The right to access, update or delete the information we have on you

section10.title: 10. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
section10.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Services and hold certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

section11.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
section11.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.

section12.title: 12. Contact Us
section12.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@pollo.lol.
